4.5.1 Identifying and documenting FMFeatureRestrictions
Because FMFeatureRestriction is based on Identifiable, it may contain the
optional attributes shortName, introduction, and desc.
[TPS_FMDT_00062] Identifying FMFeatureRestrictions ⌈The attribute short-
Name can be used to distinguish relations in case a FMFeature aggregates several
FMFeatureRestrictions.⌋
[TPS_FMDT_00063] Documenting FMFeatureRestrictions ⌈The attributes in-
troduction and desc may be used to provide a human readable description for a
FMFeatureRestriction.⌋
